---
title: "Fig. 4I - Shrb RNAi LamC+/EdU+ cells per germarium"
output: null
date: "2026-01-15"
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggprism)
library(ggpubr)
source("analysis_helpers.R")
```

```{r}
# Fig. 4I: load LamC+/EdU+ follicle cell counts by germarium.

data_file <- "../Data/Fig4I_shrbRNAi_LamC_EdU_cells_per_germarium.csv"
output_file <- "../Results/Fig4I_shrbRNAi_LamC_EdU_cells_per_germarium.pdf"

lamc_positive_cells <- read_analysis_csv(data_file)
```

```{r}
# Fig. 4I: average LamC+/EdU+ cell counts within each replicate for testing.
# Replicates are the statistical unit; each row in the raw data is one germarium.

lamc_positive_cells_summary <- lamc_positive_cells %>%
  group_by(Genotype, Group, Replicate) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_LamC_Cells = sum(Total_LamC_Cells, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_Germaria = n(),
    LamC_Cells_Per_Germarium = Total_LamC_Cells / Total_Germaria,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
# Fig. 4I: compare replicate means between control and shrb RNAi.

stat_results <- lamc_positive_cells_summary %>%
  rstatix::t_test(LamC_Cells_Per_Germarium ~ Group) %>%
  rstatix::add_significance("p") %>%
  rstatix::add_xy_position(x = "Group", step.increase = 1.2, dodge = 0.8)
print(stat_results)
```

```{r}
# Fig. 4I: plot LamC+/EdU+ cells per germarium.

plot_box_jitter(
  data = lamc_positive_cells %>%
    mutate(LamC_Cells_Per_Germarium = Total_LamC_Cells),
  summary_data = lamc_positive_cells_summary,
  x = Group,
  y = LamC_Cells_Per_Germarium,
  plot_title = "LamC+, EdU+ follicle cells per germarium",
  y_limits = c(0, 50),
  p_values = stat_results,
  bracket_size = 0.3,
  p_value_size = 2.5
)
```
```{r}
ggsave(output_file, width = 2, height = 2.5, units = "in", device = cairo_pdf)
```

```{r}
# Fig. 4I: manuscript summary values for replicate means.

summarize_mean_sd(
  lamc_positive_cells_summary,
  group_cols = "Group",
  value_col = LamC_Cells_Per_Germarium
)
```
